title: World Bloom — Ordinary, Yet Special Us — Episode9 A Familiar Voice

meta.Event Outline: Things have been going well for Leo/need since their professional debut. One day, a change in the tree in their SEKAI brings them to a dream world—one where they never became estranged.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm struggling to come up with a good melody. I thought writing the lyrics first would help, but these aren't turning out either...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I finally found what I want to do, but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho's in a professional band, Saki's the ace of the soft tennis club and Honami's working towards getting into university.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I really admire how they're all doing their very best.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I was so sure that I'd get to join them once I figured out what I want to do with myself.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm really sorry that I haven't been able to give you a chance to sing, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In any case, I need to figure out what I want this song to be about.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: At the very least, a theme... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It's a notification from that weather app.
What is it about...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Morning! Guess what? It's almost that time of year! For the Leonid meteor shower to appear!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saturday two weeks from now is supposed to be the best time to see it. Around seven in the evening, from what I've read.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's so like you to have it down to the hour.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I became curious and decided to do some digging.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, it reminds me of the time we all walked home together after trying to play as a band...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And we climbed on top of that jungle gym to watch.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And it'll be a Saturday, so maybe we can all...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um, Honami?
Do you plan on watching it this year?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Unfortunately, that weekend coincides with an open house I'll be attending.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's a little far away, so I probably won't be back until late in the evening... So, I might just have to make do with watching it from the train or on my walk home.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I thought it happening in the evening meant that we could watch together. But things just aren't that simple...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, I could postpone my visit to that university.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They hold open houses multiple times per year, but this is the only time when you can see the Leonid meteor shower.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, could you tell that I wasn't sure about whether or not to invite you...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, this is how I genuinely feel.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We'll probably have even less time once we're third-years, so I've been wanting to create another memory together while we still can.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, Miya Girls is likely going to be the last school we all attend together...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Saki and I haven't decided where we're going yet, but Honami and Shiho...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, in order to create that memory, let's go ask Saki and Shiho about all four of us seeing the meteor shower together!

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm super duper glad that they scheduled our trip for Saturday two weeks from now!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wouldn't have been able to go see your show if it was scheduled for the weekend after that!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, you could've come after you finished. You do have a monstrous amount of stamina now, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, it's not a matter of stamina. I'd never make it in time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're going to practice from dawn until dusk and then have a quick party at the end, but it takes three hours each way by bus.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You're acting all aloof.
Aren't things pretty hectic on your end too?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, it is the week leading up to our show. We'll probably be practicing in the studio nonstop.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? Hi, Ichi! Hi, Hona!
What's up?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, we were going to invite you two to come see the Leonid meteor shower with us...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, the Leonid meteor shower?! I wanna see it! When's the best time?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Saturday two weeks from now...
The peak is supposed to be around seven in the evening...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We'll probably still be in the studio...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I'll probably be on the bus...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry, you two...!
Please forget what we just said.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks for helping us with the mini planetarium, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We made as much progress as we did on the projector because of your extensive knowledge of stars.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm glad that I was able to help.
Especially since I've been going in for essay corrections after school and could never join you all right away...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I heard a girl from another class say how you have to submit a lot of assignments and they're all really hard.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's right. I'll usually go home, do my homework and spend the rest of my time either working on past problems or writing essays.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And they ask you to write about very difficult topics with terminology unique to social welfare topics...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Just writing one takes me such a long time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So even you find it hard, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, could you tell that I wasn't sure about whether or not to invite you...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, this is how I genuinely feel.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We'll probably have even less time once we're third-years, so I've been wanting to create another memory together while we still can.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, Honami? About us seeing the Leonid meteor shower...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... It is unfortunate that Saki and Shiho won't be able to join us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But as long as the two of us get to see it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I feel that you should go to that open house instead.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm really sorry. Especially since you offered to postpone your visit for me...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki and Shiho are both working really hard towards achieving their dreams.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think you should also prioritize your own dream, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I mean, what if your next opportunity to visit ends up overlapping with the date for another university? You should go to these open houses when you can!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, as long as the skies are clear, we'll be able to see the meteor shower from wherever.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, let's talk the following Monday during lunch or something. We can tell each other how many shooting stars we saw.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, I promise to fill you in that Monday.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I wish we could all see the Leonid meteor shower together...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And this really might be the last school we all attend together...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Even though we haven't had much time to talk or have lunch together, we've at least been able to see each other's smiling faces every day.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, stop...
That's all I've been thinking about since coming home.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I haven't been able to make any progress on my song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Miku...
What should I do in this kind of situation?
This song is going to let me sing with all of you in your world.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It sounds so familiar for some reason...)
This song, your thoughts, your feelings, this melody... The people who need it most are going to be so touched by them all.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I've been listening to her ever since I was little...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Through all the fun times and all the bad times.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, of course...
The only way I'd get to talk to Miku is if I were dreaming.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Did she come to try and cheer me up because I was thinking all those negative thoughts?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I saw how hard the others have been working, and decided I wanted to do something myself.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But that's not all there was to it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I really do admire what they're doing.
I think it's really cool how all three of them are working so hard, and I truly hope their dreams come true.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We won't get to be together in the future...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I believe that we'll keep being friends.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want Miku to sing what I'm feeling right now.
